Once the golden helmet is crafted, the player can rename it at an anvil. Finding the andesite_wall serves as a parallel prerequisite — the anvil for renaming is located near the andesite_wall, so the player must find that structure first before they can access the anvil to rename the helmet. This creates a diamond-shaped DAG with two branches converging on the rename task.

Player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. Max distance 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the fire.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden helmet places it in the player's inventory. The player starts with 5 gold ingots and must use the crafting table near the fire to craft the helmet. The golden_helmet was not in starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite wall structure spans from spawn-relative [-8, 0, -8] to [-6, 2, -7], with center approximately at [-7, 1, -7]. Player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have located the structure. Max distance 5 with 60° facing tolerance.

Uses inventory_has because after renaming the golden helmet at the anvil, the item remains in the player's inventory with type golden_helmet. While renaming adds NBT custom name data, the base item type stays golden_helmet. Combined with the craft_to_golden_helmet milestone already being completed (establishing the helmet exists), this milestone verifies the player still possesses the helmet after the anvil interaction. Note: The evaluator's craft_item counter also tracks anvil operations, but inventory_has is the most reliable single check since the player must retain the helmet.

scene_description: A flat grass field with two key landmarks: (1) A fire station at ~8,~8 with netherrack+fire and an adjacent crafting table for crafting the golden helmet, and (2) An andesite wall structure at ~-8,~-7 with an anvil placed at ~-7,~-6 for renaming the helmet. Player starts at origin with 5 gold ingots and 64 experience bottles.
task_text: Find the fire burning in the distance, use the nearby crafting table to craft a golden helmet from your gold ingots, then find the andesite wall structure and use the anvil next to it to rename your helmet.
design_notes: The scene has two distinct landmarks ~16 blocks apart diagonally. Fire area (NE quadrant at +8,+8) contains netherrack with fire on top and a crafting table one block away. Andesite wall area (SW quadrant at -8,-7) is a 3-wide, 3-tall L-shaped wall with an anvil placed in front of it. Player spawns at origin with gold ingots (5 for helmet recipe) and experience bottles (64 to gain levels for renaming). The two areas are clearly visible from spawn in different directions.
